title: Ploudalmézeau Hampden Memorial
memorial_details: Memorial stone (stèle) with inscribed marble tablet at the crash site, Ploudalmézeau, Finistère.
narrative: Hampden AE225 of 144 Squadron, coded PL-N, departed North Luffenham on 24 July 1941 to attack Brest. The aircraft was intercepted by a Bf 109 and shot down, crashing near Ploudalmézeau. Three crew were killed; two became prisoners of war.

sources.title: Chorley, W.R. — Bomber Command Losses Vol. 2
Tony Hibberd (RAF Bomber Command Memorials Facebook group, admin post)
